parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain the main principles behind the use of ultrasound to obtain diagnostic information about internal body structures.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The fraction of the incident intensity of an ultrasound beam that is reflected at a boundary between two media depends on the specific acoustic impedances $Z_1$ and $Z_2$ of the media.

Discuss qualitatively how the relative magnitudes of the two specific acoustic impedances affect the reflected intensity.
